notes.title: ItsyRealm v0.7.55 - Brand new tutorial!

[b]Big Things[/b]
[list]
[*]Giant performance optimizations (garbage collection, game state management, game world probes, peeps, and UI atlasing, to name a few). Upwards of a 50% performance improvement depending on computer specs. This also reduces microstuttering.[/*]
[*]Brand new cinematic tutorial! Includes an intro cutscene introducing the story, ship-vs-ship combat, attacking Cthulhu and his squids, as well as coming to an seemingly abandoned island to find some horrors lurking...[/*]
[*]Improvements to mouse picking, especially on moving maps (e.g., Behemoth, ships, etc).[/*]
[*]Improvements to high DPI on Windows and Linux. Should be a lot more playable![/*]
[*]Combat stances now have a much greater effects on combat. Controlled stance boosts accuracy and increases minimum hit; aggressive stance increases max damage more noticably based on strength level; and defensive stance actually reduces damage received based on defense level.[/*]
[*]Improvements to network latency in online play.[/*]
[/list]

[b]Small Things[/b]
[list]
[*]Remember camera settings between play-throughs and after cutscenes.[/*]
[*]Improvements to particles from different, cinematic camera angles.[/*]
[*]Fix crash when using Prisium's Wisdom prayer.[/*]
[*]Tweak lighting in Mt. Vazikerl mine.[/*]
[*]Initial work on Mt. Vazikerl mountain.[/*]
[*]Smoothen player rotation when flipping from left/right. (Really a side effect of performance optimization but it looks good!)[/*]
[/list]

[b]Tiny Things[/b]
[list]
[*]Improvements to cannon firing logic.[/*]
[*]Fix broken skilling animations.[/*]
[*]Fix Hexagram projectile being too big.[/*]
[*]Fix PlaySound causing stuck animations.[/*]
[*]Behemoth now yeets the player.[/*]
[*]Slow down mimic attack speed.[/*]
[*]Don't spawn barrel mimics on Behemoth. They get tossed anyway![/*]
[*]Clamp Nuke to bottom for tall NPCs.[/*]
[*]Fix broken scaling mechanic of Ice Barrage.[/*]
[*]Fix decapitate projectile.[/*]
[*]Fix minor issue with projectiles moving quickly.[/*]
[*]Fix potential garbage values in camera properties under certain circumstances in cutscenes.[/*]
[*]New weapon cooldown calculation. Should have no effect on DPS.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: ItsyRealm v0.7.45
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Nerf Fury power: 1. the Fury effect vanishes 20 - 30 seconds (scaling with defense level) after the last damaging attack or immediately if you dequip a shield; 2. only boosts your damage if you take damage.
[*] Add grace period to NPC/object interaction of a hair over 1/3rd a second (0.35 seconds to be exact). This means when you perform an action right before you stop moving using keyboard controls, the action will still go through.
[*] Buff Summon Goo: 1. increments in 10% debuff now; 2. maxes at 50% speed reduction
[*] Buff Bastiel's Gaze to also increase movement speed by 10% - 20% scaling with Faith level.
[*] Add flaming feet effect to Bastiel's Gaze.
[*] Update Chicken Politickin' minigame: 1. dialog now refers to the default keyboard controls; 2. damage is successfully dealt to chickens; 3. add a grace period when ending a dash and starting another to prevent failed dashes; 4. make minigame instanced.
[*] Buff bash to deal damage based on strength of shield.
[*] Overall fixes to attack cooldown & stunning mechanics. Before, Bash and Shockwave powers would reset cooldown upon being activated.
[*] Fix Ghost Binder's protection spamming the log / proving less protection from new radial combat menu DPS stats tool tip.
[*] Make target info static on screen around the radial combat menu.
[*] Fix boat foam when boat gets hit (e.g., by Mn'thrw).
[*] Bug fix: prevent player from losing stats until restarting the play session after running a few raids. This was caused by the raid party component assuming the identity of the stats component, then being removed.
[*] Bug fix: Orlando keeps attacking foes.
[*] Buff Isabelle fight after playtesting; 1. increased health to 100; 2. increased offensive stats to 20; 3. increased strength bonus and weapon style bonus to tier 15.
[*] Shift crafting requirement of mooish leather and blue cotton down one crafting level to improve low-level gameplay and be consistent with higher-level crafting requirements.
[*] Overall shift of archery weapons and magic weapons by one tier as well. For example, boomerangs are now made at level 1 and multiples of 10 instead of level 2, level 11, etc.
[*] Categorize enchanted copper amulet and enchanted copper ring as copper metal to prevent Copper Skelementals from attacking.
[*] Fix crash when values are missing from DPS tool tip in combat radial menu.
[/list]

notes.title: ItsyRealm v0.7.44
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282642/86e82104010ec953d02caaf667228e4beb2f76f9.gif[/img]

Add drops to Isabelle in the High Chambers of Yendor raid! She now drops two stacks of resources (such as arrows, mooish leather, and runes) on top of 1-5 "Isabellium shards". The shards can be used to make either "Isabelle's loot bag" or trim bronze armor to produce Isabellium armor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282642/da715e91bdf9ca7ffe1f2570e6bd0a313e3222e9.gif[/img]

Isabellium armor scales with your average (mean) combat stats (specifically attack, strength, defense, and faith and does include stat boosts). This armor is generally inferior at the same tiers as armor crafted from metal, but will scale indefinitely as you get stronger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41282642/398f7e874114755980c07dc4b5a6bdfc994f591b.png[/img]

Isabelle's loot bag can be made with 100 shards. This loot bag will give one of three legendary items: Isabelle's zweihander, Isabelle's longbow, or Isabelle's two-handed staff. These items also scale, though they use different skills to determine the average (e.g., Isabelle's two-handed staff uses magic, wisdom, and faith). Like Isabellium armor, they are generally inferior to weapons of the same tier. In addition, Isabelle's longbow uses its own infinite arrow supply and Isabelle's two-handed staff has its own built-in spell, "Isabelle Strike", that uses no runes. So even if the stats are inferior, these weapons can still be useful later on!

Isabelle also has a relatively rare chance of dropping a weapon instead of shards (roughly 1/100 for a specific weapon, 1/33 chance for any weapon).

Upon obtaining legendary items, a confetti explosion will burst from the drop! If you use obtain a weapon from Isabelle's loot bag, it will explode around the player instead.

[list]
[*] Add rewards to the Isabelle fight.
[*] Add thousand separators to boss HUD health. Of course, this only shows up for bosses with more than 999 health, of which there are currently none. 
[*] Show "infinite" in boss HUD instead of a really big number.
[*] Correctly close boss HUD when boss or bosses die and get resurrected within a couple ticks.
[*] Fix crash when spawning nymph protecting the Ancient Driftwood in Foggy Forest.
[*] Nymph doesn't summon more monsters after she dies.
[*] Added new boss music to Isabelle fight!
[*] Show quantity in tool tip for big stacks of items (over 100,000 items).
[*] Ambient lights were also acting as directional lights in forward renderer pass, causing lighting glitches with bright objects.
[*] Fix line of sight check during combat. The current tile and next tile in the line-of-sight calculations were flipped, causing erratic behavior.
[*] Added an extra entrance to High Chambers of Yendor raid. This entrance is in Isabelle's office and is accessible after completing "Calm Before the Storm."
[*] Buff fishing rod as a weapon. It now attacks faster and has a fancy animation when using Tornado!
[*] Fix bug that could cause loss of equipment when equipping new items while having an item of the same slot equipped already. The game would incorrectly unset an item's inventory slot, causing it to be lost if another item took that inventory slot.
[/list]

notes.title: ItsyRealm v0.7.41

[list]
[*] Added tier 1 - 50 fishing rods! You can craft the fishing rods with the right fishing & engineering flevel from one log, one metal fish hook, and flax fishing line. Flax fishing line can be spun from flax. A metal fishing hook can be made from one smithing a metal bar.

(This helps with equipment switching from radial combat menu not messing up your inventory.)

[*] Prevent chat input taking focus when pressing enter with a different widget (e.g., a different text input box) is focused.

notes.title: ItsyRealm v0.7.40
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix issue where Isabelle was effectively wielding the Amulet of Yendor, making her way too tough.
[*] Other tweaks to Isabelle fight: 1. She now uses the Iron Will prayer at the beginning of the fight; 2. She only resurrects the minion that complements her combat style.
[*] Rebalance combat peeps in Rumbridge. They were tier 30-35 combat, bumped it down to 15-20 at most.
[*] Rebalance damage reduction. It's a combination of two quadratic curves, one based on player's defense bonuses and foe's accuracy bonuses and the other based just on the player's defense level.
[*] Tweak ghost binder's ring to absorb damage every 1-4 turns from the undead instead of a random 25% chance.
[*] Improve anchors for all doors when opening doors.
[*] Ignore ammo bonuses if equipped but not used by the ranged weapon being used (e.g., having arrows equipped and throwing a boomerang).
[*] Disengage from combat when running out of ammo.
[*] Fix potential crashes when performing actions that spawn things. For example, if you left the Foggy Forest just as the Lumberjack tried to light a fire, the game might crash.
[*] Fix crash if player dies to Cthulhian parasite miniboss in High Chambers of Yendor. The boss would proceed to use Soul Siphon and not validate that the player was in the instance.
[/list]

[*] Improve animation priority for defending/attacking when first engaging in combat. Now attack animations always have priority.
[*] Improve zweihander "Tornado" special attack animation.
[*] More tweaks to combat XP at low levels. Base XP from combat level and hitpoints were increased at lower levels.
[*] Tweaks to resource health (for low level rocks, trees, etc) and resource weights (such as when foraging).
[*] Fix quest progress notification positioning when opened for first time during dialogue.

notes.title: ItsyRealm v0.7.37
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Prevent negative working level levels from stat drain effects.
[*] Rebalance fruit gathering weights. Now higher-level fruit are rarer/
[*] Restore working level to base level over time (one level per minute). This means if your level is drained, it will raise until your working level is restored. Similarly, if your level is boosted, it will lower over time.
[*] Add missing eat options to various recipes (carrot cake, etc).
[*] Make custom item properties (called userdata) apply stated effects upon eating / selling item.
[*] Add properties to ingredients and recipes. For example, pecans restore prayer points and apples boost constitution levels.
[*] Show potential effects of items when cooking.
[*] Fix bug where item descriptions wouldn't show entire list of custom item properties in certain situations.
[*] Fix max health and max prayer not properly updating when boosting constitution/prayer or reloading save.
[*] Fix maps going invisible when changing graphics settings on title screen.
[*] Fix soft lock in cooking tutorial when closing cooking window.
[/list]

notes.title: ItsyRealm v0.7.36
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Additional XP rebalancing.
[*] Tweaks and fixes to Super Supper Saboteur quest dialogue.
[*] Improvements to cooking window. Upon successfully cooking an item, a window will pop up with the details of the newly made item. Furthermore, the total cooking XP is now shown.
[*] Add cooking tutorial to Super Supper Saboteur. Chef Allon can show the player how to bake a carrot cake using the cooking window.
[*] Improve readability of UI tutorial hints.
[*] Improve readability of tool tips.
[*] Fix to tool tips when moving from one object of the same type to another object of the same type (e.g., from prop to prop or actor to actor). The tool tip would not update; now it does.

[*] Fix level-up notifications to not overflow the text beyond the borders of the notification box.
[*] Improve error handling when initializing the GameDB. This only affects development.
[*] Improvement to fancy cooking window: 1. made the window bigger; and 2. show ingredients that are depleted in the pending recipe (this prevents items from jumping around).
[*] Add food made from recipes to default food tab in bank.
[*] Add "churn" (milk-o-matic) to Rumbridge Farms. Turn milk into butter! (And more in the future.)
[*] Add carrot cake recipe.
[*] Add cooking actions to fruit.

[*] Added support for NPCs following the player between maps and instances.
[*] Fix issue with player pathing towards a moving peep when engaging in combat.
[*] Add dandies and undead dandies to Leafy Lake.
[*] Don't move progress notification window when dialog box is open. Before, the quest progress notification would obscure the player and NPCs they were talking to.

[*] Add more logging around mashina state transitions. This helps debugging.
[*] Add eggs to chicken drop tables.
[*] Add milk option to cows.
[*] Allow performing actions on a MapObject as well as the base Resource from the inventory 'Use' feature.
[*] Allow customizing constraints panel in code.
[*] Added screenshake to Earthquake power.

[/list]

notes.title: ItsyRealm v0.7.28
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Add keybind to continue dialog. Defaults to space.
[*] Improve examine text to go into chat box and make tooltip show longer.
[*] When failing to cut a tree, mine a rock, or fish, don't say 'any tool' of a specific type is allowed if a single specific tool is required to gather the resource.
[*] Update who Isabelle bought her island from; she now bought it from Earl Reddick of Rumbridge.
[*] Make kiting easier. The player will have a delay (about two seconds) before being dis-engaged from an opponent if it's unattackable (e.g., out of range or line of sight blocked). If the player is unable to reach the opponent and stops moving with keyboard controls, they will try and walk towards it to resume attacking again (once they are within range).
[*] Bug: don't interrupt combat in certain situations when walking using controls.
[*] Increase player speed to 10 units; decrease default creep speed to 5 units. (These units aren't easily converted to tiles/second or meters/second for example, but they can be compared; the player will be about twice as fast as all creeps that used the default speed).
[*] Make trees and anvils 'shoot-through'. This means that arrows, magic, and other projectile or long-range attacks will go through trees and anvils.
[*] Update Bessie description. She's a special cow, after all!
[*] Improve quest instructions for Calm Before the Storm. They are less repetitive and more informative now.
[*] Prevent scroll bar from overlapping item icons in crafting window.
[*] Speed up bows. Shortbows will fire every 1.2 seconds (tied with boomerangs) and longbows every 1.8 seconds.
[*] Rewrote quest code to handle quest branching (e.g., multiple endings or paths). Please note, there may be bugs with the quest log or quest progression in this release. Feel free to report any issues if you can!
[/list]
